_what: Cipher canonical generated appearance. The reproducible INPUT; the sprites it produces are build output under assets/sprites/generated/cipher/.
_decided: 2026-08-02 - short fade + deepened skin (D1), chosen from a hair spread and a two-step skin bracket. Locked as Cipher everywhere.
_scale: size 36 lands a 22x32 body, essentially the pack nominal 22x34. size 40 overshoots to 39 tall and size must be a multiple of 4, so 36 is the size. Re-frame to the 96x80 body canvas with scripts/pack_canvas.py - translation only, never scaling (body law: one canvas, integer zoom).
description: Small pixel art fighter sprite for a retro GBA-style tactics game, standing idle facing south (front view). Lean adult humanoid, slight build, about 2.5 heads tall. Deep dark brown skin, richly melanated - warm umber midtone near #5d3f2b, shadows near #3d2718, restrained highlight near #74513a. Noticeably darker than mid-brown. Short twisted locs cropped close on top with faded shaved sides, tight to the skull, near-black with warm brown highlights. NO VISIBLE EYES: a solid horizontal glowing cyan visor band runs straight across the eye line from temple to temple, unbroken, completely replacing the eyes - this is the character's signature and no eye may show anywhere. Faint pale surgical scar marks at both temples where the band meets the head. Utilitarian post-collapse streetwear in muted brown-grays: charcoal gray-brown jacket with a high collar over a darker undershirt, one simple diagonal strap across the chest, loose dark gray-brown trousers, worn brown boots, pale wrapped gloves. Minimal visible tech: a small cyan-lit device band on the left forearm, nothing ornate. Single accent color: cyan (#5ccfff) used sparingly - the visor band and the forearm device only. Everything else muted and desaturated: two or three close tones per material, gentle dithering, clustered dark shades, one soft rim highlight on the right shoulder. Selective outlining: dark outline around the outer silhouette, softer color-derived edges inside. No anti-aliasing, crisp single pixels, strong readable silhouette. Quiet grounded posture, weight even, arms relaxed at sides, no weapon drawn - a ghost operative from an underground fighting circuit who was erased from every record, practical and unshowy, not a fantasy hero.

animation._finding: Ask for a STATE, not a MOTION. A prompt naming a relationship that holds ACROSS frames ("arms swing opposite the legs") cannot be satisfied: each frame is generated on its own, nothing carries phase between them, so the relationship lands at random and rephrasing does not help. A prompt naming a per-frame property ("left hand grips the chest strap") is satisfiable by every frame independently, and holds first try. Credit: Codex.
animation._side_effect: Fewer moving parts steadied the whole upper body, not just the arms. Head-shape agreement between consecutive frames: 0.89 for the swinging take, 0.97 held. Canon measures 0.87 on the same metric — it is the sanity reference, NOT a convergence target, and the held take is deliberately steadier than canon rather than closer to it. Canon is hand-authored and re-poses its arms every frame, so some of its 0.87 is real animation. Visor width held 5-6px, inside canon’s 4-8 range. Constraint as stabiliser.
animation._fits_the_dialect: Canon barely strides - its feet travel about 1px across the whole cycle. A held upper body over cycling legs is CLOSER to the pack’s vocabulary than a swinging walk, not a compromise away from it.
animation.action_description: Walking south. Left hand grips the diagonal chest strap at mid-chest in every frame. Right hand rests at the belt pocket in every frame. Elbows remain tucked against the body. Arms do not swing and do not change sides. Only the legs cycle; the torso bobs subtly up and down. Preserve the head, visor, hair, clothing, scale and facing direction exactly.

measured._describes: the AS-GENERATED frames now shipped at assets/sprites/generated/cipher/walk/, after pack_canvas.py re-framing (translation only) and BEFORE any hand editing. Any Aseprite pass invalidates these numbers; re-measure after.

animation.residual: bob is 1px against canon’s 2px. Frames 4, 5 and 6 sit one row lower (head_y=26) than frames 1,2,3,7,8 (head_y=25); canon alternates 23/24/25. Fix is select-all and one arrow-key UP on those three frames in assets/sprites/generated/cipher/work/cipher_walk_heldarms.aseprite. Deliberately not faked in the pipeline.
dead_ends: template_animation_id (skeleton rig): re-poses and repaints the sprite; destroys the face and visor on this character.
v3 prompt asking for contralateral swing: tried twice, r=+0.67 then +0.72. Same-side both times.
half-cycle composite (upper body from frame i+4 over legs from frame i): phase measured -0.52, but the legs visibly sever at the waist. Metric good, sprite broken.

reroll for variance: two generations differed in 75% of pixels yet agreed on silhouette at IoU 0.82-0.86, which is the same as ONE walk’s frame-to-frame variation. The model has one notion of this walk.
animation._method_note: Four times tonight an aggregate metric disagreed with looking at the pixels, and looking won every time. Correlations are for quantifying a suspicion and measuring distance to a target. They do not replace rendering the frames and looking at them.

settings.frame_0: reference pose, discarded — not part of the cycle
